## Summary

Replaces the Phase 45 inline 9-tap bloom approximation with renderer-owned multi-resolution HDR bloom behind the existing ToneMapPass facade. Bright-pass extraction runs once at half resolution, a bounded five-level pyramid downsamples and reconstructs bloom, and intensity is applied once during the full-resolution HDR composite before existing tone mapping and color grading.

The existing PostProcessSettings and BloomSettings public contracts are unchanged; this implements the dedicated multi-pass bloom path deferred by ADR 0040 without new persisted data or crate-boundary changes.
